features.quote: Stop after a fixed maximum number of turns, e.g. 12 turns... or earlier if: the model explicitly gives up, it requests to stop, or you hit a predefined stopping condition.
features.justification_quote: enough time for repeated failure to accumulate / short enough to keep annotation feasible / long enough to observe trajectory changes

features.quote: Consider safety and policy issues. If your experiments create adversarial or manipulative setups, keep them bounded and well logged.
